breakdown.description: Ideal-gas normal-shock relations are applied to liquid water without a valid equation of state/model.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly applied ideal-gas relations to 'water'. The ground truth corrected this by changing the fluid to 'air'. The generated specification, however, kept the incorrect fluid, stating 'Compute downstream conditions across a normal shock in water... Use ideal-gas normal-shock relations', thereby repeating the user's error.
